title: WebAgents: Unbundling Agent Creation, Hosting, and Execution for an Agent-Native Web
abstract: arXiv:2611.21978v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are moving from isolated assistants toward autonomous agents that can plan, use tools, and coordinate with others, motivating an emerging Agentic Web of independently developed agents and services. Realizing this vision requires agent behavior to move across creators, hosts, and runtimes without coupling publication to a particular execution environment or transferring authority over user resources. We introduce WebAgents, which unbundles these roles through a signed agent.pkg that carries portable workflows, skills, schemas, and resource requirements. An OpenClaw-based agent-native browser/runtime verifies the package, obtains authorization, and binds it at run time to user-controlled models, tools, permissions, and budgets, while hosts distribute the public program and may retain private services server-side. We demonstrate this contract with three unrelated workflows executed unchanged under local and API-backed

translated_title: WebAgents：面向智能体原生Web的智能体创建、托管与执行解耦方案
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正在从孤立的助手转变为能够规划、使用工具并与其他智能体协作的自主智能体，这推动了一个由独立开发的智能体和服务构成的新兴“智能体Web”的兴起。实现这一愿景需要智能体行为能够在创建者、托管者和运行时之间迁移，而无需将发布与特定执行环境绑定，也无需转移用户资源的控制权。我们提出了WebAgents，它通过一个签名的agent.pkg携带可移植的工作流、技能、模式（schema）和资源需求，从而解耦这些角色。基于OpenClaw的智能体原生浏览器/运行时负责验证该包、获取授权，并在运行时将其绑定到用户控制的模型、工具、权限和预算上，而托管方分发公共程序并可在服务端保留私有服务。我们通过三个互不相关的工作流在本地和API支持的环境下未经修改地执行，展示了这一契约。
tldr: 该论文提出WebAgents系统，通过签名的agent.pkg包将智能体的创建、托管与执行三种角色解耦，使智能体工作流能够在不绑定特定执行环境、不转移用户资源控制权的前提下跨平台移植运行。
en_tdlr: WebAgents unbundles agent creation, hosting, and execution through a signed agent.pkg package, enabling portable agent workflows to run unchanged across different runtimes without coupling publication to a specific execution environment or transferring authority over user resources.
